description: Build an Autoview alert command string from structured order fields (symbol, side, quantity, type, price, trigger) without placing an order — the output is the value TradingView's create_alert `message` field should carry. Also builds cancel/close/flat management commands via `action` (see entry's description). Dry-run by default: a bare call returns a preview command (appends d=1); set live:true to build a command that trades for real once TradingView fires the alert. Prefer the `alert` tool if you also need the destination webhook, expiration, and resolution in one call. Requires your Autoview account token — live:true requires a live-scoped token. exchange is optional: pass one of OANDAPRACTICE, KRAKEN, CRYPTO, CRYPTODEMO, BYBITTESTNET, BYBITSPOTTESTNET, TRADOVATESIM for full order-type/bracket validation, or any other exchange id configured on Autoview (see the `catalog` tool) to build a generic command for it with that extra validation skipped; omit exchange entirely to build a generic command routed by whichever exchange(s) the destination hook is linked to.

action.description: manage EXISTING orders/positions on symbol instead of placing a new one: cancel = cancel open orders, close = close open positions, flat = cancel every order AND close every position (Tradovate only). When set, side (if given) is an optional buy/sell filter (not applicable to flat), and quantity/type/price/trigger/brackets/unit are ignored.

exchange.description: optional — one of OANDAPRACTICE, KRAKEN, CRYPTO, CRYPTODEMO, BYBITTESTNET, BYBITSPOTTESTNET, TRADOVATESIM validates order-type and bracket support against that exchange's capabilities; any other exchange id known to Autoview (see `catalog`) is also accepted but skips that check; omit entirely to skip validation

live.description: false (default) = build a dry-run preview command (appends d=1); true = build a command that places a real order when the alert fires

price.description: absolute limit price; required for limit, post_only, ioc, fok, and stop_limit

priceRef.description: reference price for percent sizing and brackets

quantity.description: order size: a positive number (contracts/units), or a percent-of-balance string like "50%" (1-100%). Required unless action is set.

side.description: order direction; required unless action is set, where it is an optional buy/sell filter for cancel/close (omit for flat)

sizeAgainstEquity.description: for a percent quantity, size against equity instead of available balance (y=equity)

stopLoss.description: attached bracket stop-loss as a POINT distance from the fill; pairs with takeProfit or a trail leg

symbol.description: the instrument symbol, e.g. EUR_USD, XBTUSD, BTC_USD — or the exchange-native symbol a TradingView EXCHANGE:TICKER maps to

takeProfit.description: attached bracket take-profit as a POINT distance from the fill; pairs with stopLoss or a trail leg

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

trailActivate.description: points of profit before the trail starts; required whenever trailStop is set

trailFrequency.description: how often the trailing stop re-checks price; defaults to 1 if omitted

trailStop.description: auto-trail stop distance in points; requires trailActivate

trigger.description: absolute trigger (stop) price; required for stop and stop_limit

unit.description: "currency" treats quantity as a CURRENCY amount to convert to units at the resolved price (u=currency) — e.g. quantity:10 with unit:"currency" on BTC/USD buys $10 of BTC instead of 10 BTC. Only meaningful with a fixed (non-percent) quantity.

name: command
